fields.summary_ko.0: Deutsche Bank upgraded Walmart (WMT) from Neutral, expecting strengthened value proposition to drive market share gains in inflationary environment.
fields.summary_ko.1: Walmart Q2 U.S. comparable store sales growth rate of 2.6% marks lowest since Q4 2020, while margin improvement underway through higher-margin business growth (advertising, membership revenue) and increased private label penetration.
